title: Fhiaba — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Fhiaba.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Italian Cooling." Luxury tier. Fhiaba makes luxury refrigeration in Treviso, Italy — built-in, freestanding, and wine storage with Italian design excellence. Extremely limited distribution in North America through specialty dealers.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Ultra-luxury Italian kitchen builds. Specialty cooling needs.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Fhiaba:

• Handcrafted in Treviso, Italy

• Ultra-premium Italian refrigeration

• Limited distribution creates exclusivity

• Stunning Italian design

• Wine storage expertise
